job.value: Go back to liked listings and check which are still available

arrivedFrom.value: The heart icon in the top nav or 'My likes' in the sidebar

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The 'Likes' heading over a grid of listing cards is self-explanatory.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The listing cards themselves are the content and the obvious thing to click.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: Cards follow the standard listing-card pattern with price, condition and a heart count.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: '2 years' / '4 years' under each seller name gives a number with no unit context (account age? when it was liked?).

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: No decisions beyond which listing to open.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Each card shows only what's needed: photo, status, title, price, condition.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: 'SOLD' and 'RESERVED' strips help the buyer see what's still available.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Photos, prices and status strips carry it.
